Eingabeformular – deine Börse wird eine: Input form – your site becomes an application
Wenn du dich bei einer App registrierst,: When you sign up for an app, you fill in a form – and in the background an INSERT INTO runs. Today you build exactly that: new animals sign up through a form, without SQL. Together with the search form, your matchmaking site is then a small application: enter data, find data.
